description: This file defines abstract classes and concrete implementations for managing window function frames in Apache Spark SQL, including offset, sliding, and unbounded window frames, with methods for preparing, writing results, and handling nulls and defaults.

classes.name: WindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Abstract base class for window function frames, providing methods for preparation, writing results, and bounds.

classes.name: OffsetWindowFunctionFrameBase
classes.description: Abstract class for offset window frames (LEAD/LAG), handling row shifting with null and default handling.

classes.name: FrameLessOffsetWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Implementation of offset window frame optimized for internal use, handling nulls and default values.

classes.name: UnboundedOffsetWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Handles frames with unbounded offset, returning constant values for the partition.

classes.name: UnboundedPrecedingOffsetWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Handles frames with unbounded preceding to current row, optimized for such cases.

classes.name: UnboundedFollowingOffsetWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Handles frames with current row to unbounded following, optimized for such cases.

classes.name: UnboundedPrecedingWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Handles frames with unbounded preceding to unbounded following, processing all rows eagerly.

classes.name: UnboundedFollowingWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Handles frames with current row to unbounded following, with optimized write method.

classes.name: SlidingWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Implements sliding window logic with bounds and buffer management for SQL frames like BETWEEN.

classes.name: UnboundedWindowFunctionFrame
classes.description: Handles frames with no explicit bounds, applying the same result to all rows.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the frame with a new set of rows, resetting internal state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the computed window function result to the target row at a given index.

methods.name: currentLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the current lower bound index of the window frame.

methods.name: currentUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the current upper bound index of the window frame.

methods.name: getNextOrNull
methods.description: Returns the next UnsafeRow from an iterator or null if none.

methods.name: findNextRowWithNonNullInput
methods.description: Finds the next row with non-null input for offset calculations.

methods.name: prepareForIgnoreNulls
methods.description: Prepares the frame to ignore nulls in offset calculations.

methods.name: prepareForRespectNulls
methods.description: Prepares the frame to respect nulls in offset calculations.

methods.name: doWrite
methods.description: Performs the actual write operation for offset frames.
